overview.purpose_zh: 这张 K 线图把每个交易日的开盘、最高、最低和收盘压进一根蜡烛，用来看这一段时间的方向、每天的波动幅度，以及最关键的价位。
works_zh: 适合看每天内部的波动，而不只是收盘价
适合找出这一段的最高价、最低价这种关键位置
uses_zh: 财经简报里讲一只股票一个月的走势
给自己定买入或卖出的参考价位

understanding.read_zh: 先看蜡烛的实体：收盘高于开盘是一根上涨的蜡烛，收盘低于开盘是一根下跌的蜡烛。实体上下两端的细线是影线，标出当天到过的最高价和最低价。再把整排蜡烛连起来看方向：这一段时间整体向上，中间只有几次小回落。最后看最长的那根影线，它给出这段时间的极值，也就是最值得记住的价位。

elements.note_zh: 实体从开盘价画到收盘价，长短就是当天涨跌的幅度。
实体上下的细线，上影线到最高价，下影线到最低价。
横向的每一格是一个交易日，一根蜡烛就是一天。
这里是最近五个收盘价的平均，用来看方向、抹平每天的噪声。

look_for_zh: 先看整体方向：收盘价从哪走到哪
再看最长的影线，它标出这段时间的最高价和最低价

observations.en: The first candle, on January 5, opens at 118 and closes at 121, with a wick down to 116 and up to 122.
observations.zh: 第一根蜡烛在一月五日，开盘 118，收盘 121，下影线到过 116，上影线到过 122。

observations.en: The highest price in the period is 158, touched on February 5; the lowest is 116, on the first day.
observations.zh: 这段时间的最高价是 158，出现在二月五日；最低价是 116，出现在第一天。

observations.en: The close climbs from 121 on January 5 to 155 on February 4, a gain of 34 dollars.
observations.zh: 收盘价从一月五日的 121 涨到二月四日的 155，一共上涨 34 美元。

observations.en: Only eight candles close below their open; the rest close higher, so buyers dominate the period.
observations.zh: 只有八根蜡烛的收盘价低于开盘价，其余都收得更高，说明这段时间买方占主导。

observations.en: January 28 is the widest candle, running from 142 to 150, a range of 8 dollars in one day.
observations.zh: 一月二十八日是最宽的一根蜡烛，从 142 到 150，一天之内跨度 8 美元。

describe.en: The candlestick chart measures the daily share price in US dollars, with one candle for each trading day from January 5 to February 5.
describe.zh: 这张 K 线图用美元衡量每日股价，一月五日到二月五日每个交易日一根蜡烛。
describe.pattern: The chart measures + metric + in + unit
alternatives: The chart shows four prices for every trading day: open, high, low and close.
Each candle covers one trading day of Northwind Systems stock.
describe.note_zh: 开头交代单位是一根蜡烛四个价，读者才知道实体和影线各代表什么。

describe.en: The share price rose from 118 on January 5 to 158 on February 5.
describe.zh: 股价从一月五日的 118 涨到二月五日的 158。
alternatives: The stock rose by 40 dollars over the period.
The price climbed from the 118 area into the 150s.
describe.note_zh: 两个端点都给，读者不用自己算；只想说涨幅时用 rose by 40。

describe.en: The share price fluctuated between 116 and 158 dollars during the period.
describe.zh: 这段时间里，股价在 116 到 158 美元之间上下波动。
alternatives: The stock moved between 116 and 158 over the month.
describe.note_zh: fluctuate 说的是来回上下；这里整体向上，但每天都在动，所以两者可以同时成立。

describe.en: The share price hit a high of 158 on February 5.
describe.zh: 股价在二月五日创下 158 的高点。
alternatives: The highest trade of the month was 158.
The stock reached its highest price, 158, at the start of February.
describe.note_zh: hit a high of 说的是价格本身最高，不是涨幅最大；别和 the biggest gain 混用。

describe.en: It hit a low of 116 on January 5, the first day of the period.
describe.zh: 它在一月五日，也就是这段时间的第一天，跌到 116 的低点。
alternatives: The lowest price of the month was 116.
The stock's lowest point, 116, came on the opening day.
describe.note_zh: 低点常和回升一起讲，说 It hit a low of 116 before recovering 更有画面。

describe.en: The close dipped to 134 on January 16 before recovering to 137 on January 19.
describe.zh: 收盘价在一月十六日小幅跌到 134，随后在一月十九日回升到 137。
alternatives: The price dipped from 136 to 134 in the middle of January.
A short dip to 134 was followed by a recovery.
describe.note_zh: dip 强调短暂、幅度小，后面往往会回升；长期下跌不要用 dip。

academic.en: The candlestick chart presents the daily share price of Northwind Systems from January 5 to February 5, 2026, together with a five-day moving average. Each candle covers one trading day and records four prices: open, high, low and close. The body spans the open and the close, while the wicks mark the highest and lowest prices reached during the day. The series opens at 118 and closes at 153 on the final day. The highest price, 158, is touched on February 5, and the lowest, 116, on January 5. Only eight days close below their open, and the moving average rises through almost the entire period.
academic.zh: 这张 K 线图呈现 Northwind Systems 在 2026 年一月 5 日到二月 5 日的每日股价，并附一条五日均线。每根蜡烛覆盖一个交易日，记录四个价格：开盘、最高、最低和收盘。实体从开盘延伸到收盘，影线标出当天触及的最高价和最低价。整段行情从 118 开盘，最后一天收在 153。最高价 158 出现在二月 5 日，最低价 116 出现在一月 5 日。只有八天收在开盘价之下，均线几乎整段都在上升。

business.en: Our stock has moved from the 118 area into the 150s within a month, and the rise has been unusually orderly. The close climbed from 121 on January 5 to 155 on February 4, a gain of 34 dollars, and the peak of the period, 158, came on February 5. Only eight candles end below their open, so sellers have had very little control. For our position, the level that matters is 116; a close below the low of the first day would break a pattern that has held all month. We should keep the position and set an alert at that level.
business.zh: 我们的股票一个月里从 118 一带走到 150 多，而且涨得很平稳。收盘价从一月 5 日的 121 升到二月 4 日的 155，涨了 34 美元，期间最高价 158 出现在二月 5 日。只有八根蜡烛收在开盘价之下，卖方几乎没占过上风。对我们的持仓来说，关键价位是 116：收盘跌破第一天的低点，持续了一个月的形态就被打破。我们应该继续持有，并在这一价位设置提醒。

simple.en: One candle is one day of trading. The thick part shows where the price opened and where it closed. The thin lines above and below show the highest and lowest prices of that day. When the close is higher than the open, it was a good day. When the close is lower, it was a bad day. The stock started at 118 dollars and reached 158 dollars about a month later. The lowest price was 116. Only eight days ended lower than they started.
simple.zh: 一根蜡烛是一个交易日。粗的部分表示开盘价和收盘价，上下细线是当天的最高价和最低价。收盘比开盘高，那天就是涨；收盘比开盘低，那天就是跌。这只股票从 118 美元开始，大约一个月后到了 158 美元。最低价是 116。只有八天收得比开盘低。

language_notes.title_en: open and close as verbs and nouns
language_notes.body_zh: open 和 close 在这张图里既是动词也是名词：说动作时 The stock opened at 118 and closed at 121；说某个价位时用 the open、the close，前面加 the。high 和 low 也是同样的用法。
examples: The stock opened at 118 and closed at 121 on January 5.
Its high was 122 and its low was 116.

language_notes.body_zh: by 后面是涨了多少，to 后面是涨到哪个价位，同一个数只能选一种说法。The close rose by 34 to 155 把涨幅和终点一起给出，读者最清楚。
examples: The close rose by 34 dollars, from 121 to 155.
The close rose to 155 on February 4.

language_notes.title_en: one candle is one trading day
language_notes.body_zh: 不要把一根蜡烛当成一笔交易，它是一整天的汇总。指某一天用 the + 日期 + candle，或者 on + 日期，不要写 in the candle。
examples: The February 5 candle reached a high of 158.
Each candle covers one trading day, not one trade.
